beats.say: Free Wi-Fi at the cafe is handy, but think before you log in to your bank.
On an open network, other people on it may be able to snoop on what you send.
Sites with the little padlock are encrypted, which helps. But fake hotspots still exist.
For anything private, switch to your mobile data instead. It is usually safer.
If you must use public Wi-Fi, stick to browsing and skip banking.
Save this for your next trip, and share it with a friend who travels a lot.
